scope: primary literature interface for the universal common-EB Dirichlet comparison

opportunities.proposed_statement: For every finite dimension d, every positive frame Q=sum_i |A_i><A_i| on traceless Hermitians, and every normalized symmetric tripartite Choi state R with all one-body marginals tau=I/d and R_AB=R_AC the Choi marginal of a unital Hilbert-Schmidt-self-adjoint CPTP map, prove Tr[R W(Q)] <= V(Q)+k(Q), where W(Q)=sum_i A_i^T tensor (A_i^B+A_i^C).
opportunities.equivalent_gate: 2 s_Phi(Q) <= V(Q)+k(Q), the supplied sharp-C=2 condition G2/G3.
opportunities.known_exact_interface: V(Q)-k(Q) is the common pure-state variance convex roof at tau and equals a separable-coupling optimal-transport self-distance; k(Q) is exactly the equal-marginal separable two-body support.
why_imported_results_stop: The Fisher-information convex roof is exact for one observable; the all-observable joint-roof lower bound by the sum of individual QFIs is zero at tau.
The exact two-body support theorem optimizes over separable couplings, while legal symmetric Choi marginals may be entangled and only two-extendible.
Available isotropic shareability tradeoffs impose isotropic symmetry and do not bound arbitrary frame scores.
Simultaneous-measurement error tradeoffs are state-dependent for a chosen family and do not quantify over legal broadcast Choi states.
opportunities.decisive_falsifier: An exact finite d, frame Q and legal R with Tr[R W(Q)]>V(Q)+k(Q) refutes sharp C=2; a rigorous sequence with (V-k)/(V-s_Phi) diverging is required to refute every universal finite C.
opportunities.provenance: G1-G3 and legal-R assumptions are supplied in work/agents/broadcasting_proof_sol/GENERAL_GATE_AND_FAILED_ROUTES.txt; literature statements were checked against the pinned official arXiv HTML snapshots listed in REPORT.txt. No universal result or novelty claim is inferred.
